cues.text: In Naimisha forest, the sages gather and ask for the tale.
Seven sons to the river; the eighth remains.
Devavrata renounces all. He becomes Bhishma.
Three heirs; one throne; no easy answer.
A hundred cousins, five brothers, one abandoned child.
Arjuna excels. Ekalavya pays with his thumb.
The lacquer house burns. The Pandavas escape.
Bhima faces hunger in the forest.
The bow chooses Arjuna. Draupadi weds five.
